items.title: The Maurice Denis Museum was opened in the artist's home in the Parisian suburb of Saint-Germain-en-Laye.
A major retrospective exhibition took place in 1995 at the UK's Walker Art Gallery in Liverpool.
A similar exhibition was mounted at the Musée Des Beaux Arts de Montréal in 2007; it was the first major Denis show in North America.
